before: God is not God to himself, but the stones are regarded as gods.
The maker is not a maker, yet the works of the hands are makers—the engravings of the fingers, the forms of the iron which the coppersmith breathed forth and the refiner purified.
The anvil hollowed the belly, the hammer broadened the back, raised the shoulder, lifted the neck; the head was bronzed and the skull set upon it.
Then the stylus deepened the ear and curved the nostrils, traced the lips, anointed the eyes, shaped the pupils, braided locks, circled the brows and joined the eyelids.
Hence the enemy leaped upon life.
The command 'You shall not murder' was mocked (Exodus 20:13).
'You shall not commit adultery' was played with (Exodus 20:14).
'You shall not steal' was hung up (Exodus 20:15).
'You shall not bear false witness' was deemed nonsense and a fable (Exodus 20:16).
'You shall not covet anything that belongs to your neighbor' was felt as a hateful command to life (Exodus 20:17).
And the law existed as foreign to the state.

Then Procopius stepped into the midst and set forth this common admonition to the drunken: 'Men, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another? Why, though being slain by one another's swords, do you not perceive it? And why does each of you fail to know his own kin, or to perceive that you are shot with your neighbor's arrows? Lend me your eyes, you who are blind in mind — or rather your feet, you who are lame in understanding; first grant me this.'is.'is.'
Blessed indeed is the man who endures temptation.
Do not avoid persecutions, since 'Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven' (Matthew 5:10).
Do not fear the dangers of Hades; 'For the cords of Sheol encompassed me, and I called upon the name of the Lord,' says David, and as an ally he met me from heaven (Psalm 18:4).
Do not let cowardice be death; for just now, as the church is singing, you have heard 'Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints,' and exceedingly so it is (Psalm 116:15).
